name: Florida
agency: Florida Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles (FLHSMV)

teen.nightLimit: Learner: daylight only for 3 months, then until 10 pm. Licensed at 16: not 11 pm–6 am; at 17: not 1 am–5 am (unless to/from work or with a licensed driver 21+).
teen.phone: Texting while driving is illegal; no handheld device in school zones, school crossings or work zones.

notes: Checked against the Official Florida Driver License Handbook, English, rev. 08/2023 (text supplied by the owner, 2026-10-08). Questions carry printed page numbers.
Knowledge test given only in English since 2026 (FLHSMV, per news reports and county tax collector pages, 2026-10-09). The handbook states 50 questions; the 40-to-pass mark is not in the handbook.
